This indicates continued community interest and practical application of Meta's latest LLM releases.

The tags confirm its association with key AI technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Apple sues OpenAI after ex-engineer allegedly used bug to steal trade secrets
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Apple is suing OpenAI over alleged theft of trade secrets.
The lawsuit centers on a former Apple engineer allegedly exploiting a bug.
OpenAI is accused of conspiring with ex-Apple employees in the theft.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.

It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the DeepSeek-V4-Pro model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML ecosystem components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and 8VC.
Ollama currently serves a substantial developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speed improvements reach up to 90% faster when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run locally on the user's own hardware.
It integrates native support for Ollama, facilitating the use of local LLMs.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, has integrated support for MLX.
This integration enables faster performance when running Ollama specifically on Apple Silicon hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview release, indicating ongoing development.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging applications with local AI coding agents.
The core value proposition is running AI entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
stories.author: Kai Chen
bullet_points: Current large language models primarily rely on text pretraining, overlooking crucial visual information.
The paper addresses the limitation of text-only models by arguing that visual cues (figures, equations, layouts) carry rich knowledge.
The research proposes a scalable visual pretraining approach to integrate visual representations into language intelligence models.

stories.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
stories.author: Max Lübbering
bullet_points: Introduction of Soofi S, a sovereign, open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model.
The model offers significant throughput advantages for long-context deployment by activating only 3B of its 30B parameters per token.
It is specifically trained for German and English, with deliberate up-weighting of German data, matching performance of large dense models.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving capabilities on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The new feature set includes the capability for web search integration in Claude Code.
This update enhances the capabilities of local LLM orchestration tools like Ollama.

stories.title: Microsoft tests Windows Search without all the ads and fluff
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Microsoft is testing a streamlined version of the Windows 11 search menu.
The new version removes recommended content and advertisements from the search interface.
This feature is being rolled out to Windows Insiders in the Experimental channel as part of efforts to improve user trust.

stories.title: OnePlus is reportedly bailing on the US
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: OnePlus and its parent company, Oppo, are reportedly planning to exit the US and European markets.
This potential departure concludes months of speculation regarding the future direction of the OnePlus brand.
The news originates from a machine translation of a WinFuture report, suggesting it is currently unconfirmed.

stories.title: Apple’s public betas for iOS 27 and more are out now
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Public betas for iOS 27 and other major OS updates have been released by Apple.
The headline feature is the revamped, AI-powered Siri.
The article notes that the new Siri AI functionality is functional, which is highlighted as a positive.

stories.title: Siri AI makes the Apple Watch finally feel like a wrist computer
stories.author: Victoria Song
bullet_points: watchOS 27 developer beta introduces significant improvements to Siri on the Apple Watch.
The update aims to transform the Apple Watch from a basic utility into a more capable 'wrist computer' via enhanced Siri functionality.
The article suggests that Siri's utility on the Apple Watch has historically been limited, but the new features address this gap.

stories.title: The US government warns that Russia state hackers are coming after your router
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: CISA has issued a warning regarding cyber threats targeting residential routers.
The threat specifically points to state-sponsored hacking groups originating from Russia.
The warning is contextualized against the current trend of increased use of residential proxies.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone strikes forced Russia to stop shipping in vital sea corridor
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Ukrainian drone attacks successfully disrupted Russian shipping operations.
The disruption specifically targeted the Sea of Azov corridor.
The impact was achieved rapidly, within less than a week.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG signals during dream states.
Moves beyond traditional PSD and statistical features used in current dream detection methods.
Employs Persistent Homology concepts to classify dream content and condition neural signal synthesis.

stories.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
stories.author: Miguel P. Eckstein
bullet_points: The paper addresses limitations in current Vision-Language Model (VLM) evaluations, which often rely on simple datasets like MS-COCO.
It introduces the Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset, specifically designed to test VLMs on complex human interactions and behaviors.
The research focuses on analyzing the evolution of VLM accuracy and identifying specific types of visual-cognitive errors in these models.

stories.title: VEXAIoT: Autonomous IoT Vulnerability EXploitation using AI Agents
stories.author: Maanak Gupta
bullet_points: Introduces VEXAIoT, an autonomous multi-agent framework designed to exploit vulnerabilities in IoT systems.
Addresses the inherent security weaknesses of IoT devices (constrained hardware, outdated firmware).
Applies advanced AI agent technology, typically used in penetration testing, specifically to the unexplored domain of IoT vulnerability exploitation.

stories.title: ConceptSMILE: Auditing the Trustworthiness of Concept-Based Explainable AI
stories.author: Zhibao Mian
bullet_points: Introduces ConceptSMILE, a new model-agnostic framework for auditing concept-based Explainable AI (XAI).
Addresses the critical issue that concept-level explanations, while human-understandable, lack inherent trustworthiness.
Extends perturbation-based auditing logic from traditional feature/region attribution to the level of human-understandable concepts.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Addresses the 'fraud collapse' issue in financial anomaly detection caused by extreme class imbalance.
Introduces Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework.
Novelty lies in synthesizing heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for better feature encoding.

stories.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
stories.author: Hui-liang Shen
bullet_points: Introduces 4DR360, a new method for joint 3D detection and occupancy prediction using radar-camera fusion.
Addresses the limitation of sparse radar returns by integrating radar and camera data for comprehensive scene understanding.
Improves upon existing methods by enabling better interaction between detection and occupancy prediction tasks.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Introduces 'Agora,' a new framework designed to improve LLM agent reasoning.
Addresses limitations in current LLM orchestration by moving beyond coarse-grained task matching.
Uses an auction-based mechanism to allocate tasks, considering performance variability and cost efficiency among expert models.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG data related to dream states.
Moves beyond traditional PSD and statistical features used in current dream detection methods.
Utilizes Persistent Homology concepts via Takens delay embedding for advanced signal analysis and classification.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Addresses the 'fraud collapse' problem in financial anomaly detection caused by extreme class imbalance.
Introduces Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework to handle this imbalance.
Novelty lies in synthesizing heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for encoding.

stories.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
stories.author: Ulf Schlichtmann
bullet_points: LLMs are being explored to address bottlenecks in front-end chip design due to increasing complexity and time-to-market pressures.
LLMs show potential to act as a unified intelligent interface for various EDA tasks, including HDL generation and testbench construction.
The integration of agentic AI is highlighted as a key area driving the potential application of LLMs in hardware design.

stories.title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
stories.author: Haiqian Yang
bullet_points: Modern AI systems are limited by fixed representational frames, including vocabulary and solution spaces.
The paper addresses the 'Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps' in open-ended AI capabilities.
It argues for moving beyond pre-supplied, fixed frameworks to enable stronger reasoning and long-horizon tasks.

stories.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
stories.author: Kentaro Inui
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit failures in basic object counting despite overall strong multimodal performance.
Research suggests VLMs may internally encode the correct count, even when their verbalized output is incorrect.
Nonlinear probes applied to VLM activations can reliably detect these counting errors, pointing to a representation-to-output gap.

stories.title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
stories.author: Richard Gao
bullet_points: Introduces CoCoT-EEG, a new model combining contrastive learning and multiscale convolutional transformers for EEG decoding.
Addresses limitations of current EEG decoding methods, specifically the suboptimal performance of raw EEG tokenization and masked reconstruction pretraining due to high noise.
Proposes a novel approach tailored for EEG data characteristics, focusing on capturing information within narrow frequency bands.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Introduces 'Agora,' a new framework to improve LLM agent reasoning.
Addresses limitations in current LLM orchestration by moving beyond coarse-grained task matching.
Uses an auction-based mechanism to allocate tasks, considering performance variability and cost efficiency among expert models.

stories.title: Tokenizer Transplantation: Mitigating Autoregressive Collapse in Edge-Efficient Bengali ASR
stories.author: Md. Abdur Rahman
bullet_points: Addresses a critical challenge in deploying lightweight ASR models on edge devices for morphologically rich languages like Bengali.
Identifies the root cause of model failure as the use of an English-centric byte-level tokenizer, leading to autoregressive collapse.
Proposes a novel 'vocabulary transplantation pipeline' as a solution to improve performance on non-Latin languages.

stories.title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
stories.author: Mustafa Yavuz
bullet_points: Introduction of Freya-TTS, a new text-to-speech model specifically designed for Turkish language synthesis.
The model utilizes a compact, tokenizer-free, 183.2M-parameter non-autoregressive Conditional Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT).
Freya-TTS operates in the frozen latent space of AudioVAE2, enabling efficient text-to-latent mapping while maintaining high-quality audio reconstruction.

stories.title: Neural Collapse Is Forbidden: Information Floors in Language Models
stories.author: Bruno Abrahao
bullet_points: The paper challenges the notion of 'incomplete neural collapse' in language models, proposing that within-class variance represents allocated information storage.
Analysis shows that macro-category structure accounts for only 4-12% of representational variance, while within-token context dominates with 79-91%.
The findings suggest a stable allocation of representational variance across various language models, independent of parameter count.

stories.title: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API, benchmarked against Whisper and its predecessor
stories.author: get-inscribe
bullet_points: Apple has released a new SpeechAnalyzer API for speech processing.
The new API is being benchmarked against OpenAI's Whisper model.
This indicates Apple is actively competing in the advanced speech recognition market.

stories.title: Porting Gemma-4 (2B / 4B / 12B) to AWS Inferentia2
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: The article details the technical challenges of deploying Google's Gemma-4 models on AWS Inferentia2 hardware.
It specifically discusses roadblocks encountered with various optimization frameworks, including vLLM, optimum-neuron, and NxD.
The analysis highlights limitations related to the neuronx-cc compiler when porting the model.
